name: kickoff_outcome_a_tie_is_scored_by_the_latest_touch_step
description: A symmetric 50/50: blue at (0,-1300) and orange at (0,1300) boost at the ball and both touch it on the same step (frame 17): no first touch. The ball is then fought over and ends in the air near the centre (frame 48: y = -106, vy = -706). Possession now comes from the LATEST touch step: on this run frame 48 had blue alone, so blue +0.2 and orange -0.2, giving blue +0.137 / orange -0.137 (+1.6 / -1.6 at weight 12). A step where BOTH teams touch counts for neither (possession 0); this race is decided by who really touched last, not by player order. Verified independently: the formula re-evaluated by a separate script on the ball state and touches read from the exported run reproduces the reward to 5 digits.

expect.intent: the last touch was blue's alone: +0.137
